close_reason: Renamed metadata-types README H2 from 'Filter-algebra exclusion' to 'Filter extensibility' matching the 6 sibling type crates. Added one sentence to the body emphasizing metadata-types' role as the IETF-track escape hatch (the special content the original section name was hinting at).
description:
**Files**:
- crate-jmap-metadata-types/README.md — H2 heading \`## Filter-algebra exclusion\`
- crate-jmap-mail-types/README.md — H2 heading \`## Filter extensibility\`
- crate-jmap-calendars-types/README.md — H2 heading \`## Filter extensibility\`
- crate-jmap-tasks-types/README.md — H2 heading \`## Filter extensibility\`
- crate-jmap-contacts-types/README.md — H2 heading \`## Filter extensibility\`
- crate-jmap-filenode-types/README.md — H2 heading \`## Filter extensibility\`
- crate-jmap-sharing-types/README.md — H2 heading \`## Filter extensibility\`

**Divergence**: 6 of 7 type crates that mention the policy use the H2 \`## Filter extensibility\`. metadata-types is the outlier with \`## Filter-algebra exclusion\`. Both names describe the same workspace decision (AGENTS.md JMAP-lbdy: filter algebra is excluded from the extras-preservation pattern because silent-drop of unknown clauses is a query-correctness bug).

**What goes wrong**:
1. Reader scanning READMEs across the workspace can't grep for one consistent heading to find the policy explanation.
2. \`metadata-types\`'s special status (it IS the IETF-track mechanism that gives vendors a way out of the filter-algebra restriction) is real — the section content does deserve a distinct framing. But the name should still be the workspace-consistent one, with a sub-heading or first-paragraph emphasis on metadata's role.

**Fix**: rename metadata-types README's H2 to \`## Filter extensibility\` and let the body text emphasize that this crate provides the canonical escape mechanism. Or rename the OTHER 6 to \`## Filter-algebra exclusion\` if that name is judged clearer — but pick one.

**Priority**: P3 — purely a documentation surface consistency issue. The cross-crate references between the two names are already in place via prose links in AGENTS.md and PLAN.md.
title: README section name `Filter-algebra exclusion` (metadata-types) vs `Filter extensibility` (5 sibling crates) — same workspace policy under two names
